accepted.s: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1871, was primarily associated with which of the following actions?
o: It created the first Tribal Advisory Councils
It granted Scheduled Tribe status to nomadic communities
It declared certain communities as hereditary criminals
It abolished the system of bonded labour
accepted.x: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1871 branded approximately 200 communities as ‘hereditary criminals’.
accepted.tq: Test the exact legal consequence of the enactment rather than its date.
accepted.sec: Denotified and nomadic tribes - Criminal Tribes Act, repeal, replacement

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Criminal Tribes Act:
1. The Act was amended in 1924.
2. It was repealed on 31 August 1952.
3. Its repeal followed the report of the All India Criminal Tribes Inquiry Committee.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Act was amended in 1924 and repealed on 31 August 1952 following the All India Criminal Tribes Inquiry Committee report.
accepted.tq: Check the date, amendment and institutional link separately before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Denotified and nomadic tribes - Criminal Tribes Act, repeal, replacement

accepted.s: The communities formerly notified under the Criminal Tribes Act came to be known as ‘Denotified’ communities because
o: they were given a separate constitutional category
the Act was repealed and their criminal-tribe notification was removed
they were permanently settled by the Union Government
they were included in the list of Scheduled Castes throughout India
accepted.x: They became known as Denotified Tribes after the repeal of the Criminal Tribes Act and removal of the earlier notification.
accepted.tq: Link the change in legal status with the terminology used for the communities.
accepted.sec: Denotified and nomadic tribes - Criminal Tribes Act, repeal, replacement

accepted.s: The Criminal Tribes Act, 1871 was replaced, after its repeal, by
o: the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes Act
the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act
accepted.x: The Criminal Tribes Act was replaced by Habitual Offenders Acts enacted by the States.
accepted.tq: Use the authority-level trap: the replacement legislation was enacted by States.
accepted.sec: Denotified and nomadic tribes - Criminal Tribes Act, repeal, replacement

accepted.s: Which one of the following best describes nomadic tribes?
o: Communities having no permanent settlement and including pastoralists, hunters and entertainers
Communities identified exclusively on the basis of a common language
Communities restricted to urban industrial employment
Communities residing permanently in forest villages and practising only settled agriculture
accepted.x: Nomadic tribes do not have permanent settlements; pastoralists, hunters and entertainers are among the groups included in this description.
accepted.tq: Choose the comprehensive definition rather than a single occupational example.
accepted.sec: Denotified and nomadic tribes - Criminal Tribes Act, repeal, replacement

accepted.x: All three pairs are correctly matched: the Idate Commission was associated with 2017, the Renke Commission with 2008, and the All India Criminal Tribes Inquiry Committee with 1949.

accepted.sec: Denotified and nomadic tribes - Criminal Tribes Act, repeal, replacement

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the proposed enumeration of Denotified and nomadic tribes is correct?
o: The Census 2027 permanently created a separate legal category for them.
The Union Government rejected all enumeration of these communities in 2026.
The Registrar General of India agreed on 30 January 2026 to enumerate them in Census 2027.
The communities were first enumerated in the Census of 1941.
accepted.x: The Registrar General of India agreed on 30 January 2026 to enumerate DNTs in Census 2027. The Centre stated in February 2026 that there was no proposal for a separate legal category.
accepted.tq: Separate the administrative enumeration decision from the legal-category demand.
accepted.sec: Denotified and nomadic tribes - Criminal Tribes Act, repeal, replacement

accepted.s: The Chenchu tribe is traditionally associated with which of the following habitats and occupations?
accepted.x: The Chenchus, a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group, inhabit the Nallamala forest and Srisailam region and are traditionally hunter-gatherers.
accepted.tq: Match the tribe with both its habitat and characteristic livelihood.

accepted.s: Which of the following tribes are associated with the north coastal hill tracts on the Srikakulam side of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Savara (Sora) and Jatapu are associated with the north coastal hill tracts, particularly the Srikakulam side.
accepted.tq: Distinguish neighbouring tribal habitats through the regional clue.

accepted.s: The Shompen-related controversy concerning the Great Nicobar project involves alleged pressure on the tribe and raises issues relating to
o: the Criminal Tribes Act, 1871 and the Habitual Offenders Acts
the Sixth Schedule and the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act
the National Commission for Backward Classes Act and urban land rights
protection under the A&N (Protection of Aboriginal Tribes) Regulation, 1956 and habitat rights under Section 3(1)(e) of the Forest Rights Act
